items.title: Presentation: Enchant Your AI and APIs with eBPF Magic 🪄
items.blurb: Dan Finneran discusses the risks of unowned AI-generated code in production and demonstrates how eBPF can intercept and control AI API traffic in Kubernetes.

items.title: Microsoft Releases Aspire 13.5 With a Refreshed Dashboard and Workflow Improvements
items.blurb: Last week, Microsoft released Aspire 13.5, an update that refreshes the dashboard and the aspire.dev homepage and adds several quality-of-life features.

items.title: Flux Mirror Uses Gitless GitOps to Keep Software Supply Chain Under Control
items.blurb: Flux has introduced Flux Mirror, a CLI plugin that mirrors container images, Helm charts and OCI artifacts between registries from a declarative configuration.

items.title: Kubeflow Expands AI Capabilities as CNCF Graduation Nears
items.blurb: The Kubeflow project has unveiled several technical updates to enhance distributed AI and high-performance computing on Kubernetes.
